home.bannerBody: New NWU papers land in the library regularly — search by subject, module, and grade.
home.liveAnchorUnavailable: The library is being refreshed — papers are added regularly. Check back soon.
home.heroSubtitle: SCHOOL iyakuxhumanisa nefundzi ebafundza emnyangweni ofanayo, kuleyunivesitesi yakho, ngekuhlonitjwa lokufanayo — ngako hhayi umbuzo ungasali ungakapheli. Emaphepha lakahle, AI tutor, umbuto wesikhatsi sonkhe, nesihlelo setulu sekufundza — konkhe kuphatsiwa kusetjentiswa lesikhethekile lesibusise ngendleko lefanele.
home.proofDetail0: Tilayini tekucala emahlale ekolishi laCAPS kanye nekusekelwa kwalo kwe-NWU kuse kuhlangene.
home.proofDetail1: Yakhiwe ngembela lelufana lamashumi emakethe lebizwe — asikube nelitika levuliwe kusiwela kudla kwemifanekiso lefundzisako.
home.proofDetail2: Setjentiswa kucala kuncitshane. Hha kuzuza vidiyo, hha ukubophela layisha.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Emagumbi emnyango ugcina imibuto kufaka kucaphula kwakho. Iminiketo lemukelwa iphumelela Scholar Credits. Ukuhlanganyela njalo kusho kute akesabi ukubuta.
home.step01Body: Buza emgibeni wakho womnyango. Sebenzisa kahle noma kubitekile — lokushawu emakhampasi ayafuna lokufanayo.
home.step02Body: Tifundzi letati akaqina kutfola imphendvulo. Sebenzisa 'umbuto ofanayo' utoboniswa naseliphendvulwe.
home.step03Body: Maka lobuya nje njengemphendvulo. Ophendvula uthole 20 Scholar Credits. Bonkhe bayadvuduka.
home.featureAskModuleDesc: Beka umbuto egumbini lakho lomnyango bese uthola imphendvulo kutibangani labasivele baphuma lombusela. Maka imphendvulo njengekuphumelela uhole Scholar Credits.
home.featureAiTutorDesc: Asecelulwane lefundzisa lesijwayelekile. Buza mayelana nemodyuli yakho ethize, umtsetfo walikelembiso sakhe, noma sikhuti lengthangeni lenkhulumo yalelivike. Yati konteyindi yakho.
home.featurePastPapersDesc: Emaphepha lakahle asemaphandlasi ntu, emahlalane, nesikhati. Akunamfishi leya kuyibeka. Luhlelo loluphelele lwemvuma yase SA lwemibhalo yakusesephakadze.
home.featureDailyQuizDesc: Umbuto ondedzele ngulilanga. Umisa tindzawo takho letibutsi kanye nawe niph=olisha imibutfo lepakicwa kuhlatsa. Komisa iph'adresse lakho liphikelelise sibekelo.
home.featurePlannerDesc: Kwakuphi kuya ku li-CAPS sekushayelwa. Basebentisa umgaco ukuze u bani we yunivesithi. Umbalelonke wakho, uhlolwa lokhu lesidingeka ekutseni kusiqedi.
home.featureGamesDesc: IBRASIL, umbuso wemiphitsilani kulivakashi sifanisi sihlakalo, uyaphi namuhla. Igama Dash — umbumbuto tization imso weScholar Credits — usho lacha. Imininingwane itaga hathifika.
home.whySchoolSubtitle: Yakhiwe kuba bana bavelaphi base Ningizimu Afrika — hhayi njengeplatform lap sikhumbayiwemhlaba ngentenande yentevukata kuvatazinganelo.
home.trustCopy0: IGrade R kuya ku postgrad. Luhlelo lwekucabangete imikomwako nende limodyuli nemikhtli yokendzeleka Ngasokuthriphi
home.trustCopy1: Ukukhanyisela ngxenye yesiseko bộ. Akukho selembisa lidleli kabhodi ya SA. Kuninsingo leyayintfo, onkhe lapho kufanele ashone ikile onkhe kutintfombe kutintswe.
home.trustCopy2: Umphakathi, AI tutor, emaphepha lakahlemin'esebenthile, umbuto wesikhatsi sonkhe, sicelinako sekufundza, kanye nemidlalo — konkhe ngaphansi kwesakhiwo lesita
home.trustCopy3: Lutsakiso nawutjela kabanzi. Akukho lokuphineka kwetinkhomliso, akukhona kujabulisa lamalitela. SCHOOL kuyakhona kulihlangana.
home.liveAnchorLastAdded: Ibhungo lika secwebele umtsetfwa {relativeDate}. Ibhungo ligamla ngwekuhungela.
home.liveAnchorFeaturesBody: Wetse kwakha zelula leyivutw'kutsa hlola konkhe lesivulelekileyo nale kutsa lengebke lapho uhamba yale
home.missionHeading: Yakhelwe yena wonkhe Umningizimu Afrika. Yakhiwe kuyekelwa ngalokwakhiwa rim.
home.missionPara1: Ilanga laqdolwa ngu Moloti Ditshego hhayi njengalesinke yase kholi, kepha lokh nguphondo lonompilo lwezocuke, lbuhubho lwesikompilo nentsembu yetse indlela bekuti, nakuba kwalyo zeyoke zezikumbele eti Intfo yentsha lake loznidembela.
home.missionPara2: Ubuciko kunye nekhiya yokwakha lencwadzi kubuyisisa kahle futsi akubizi kutsenga. Kwabutfwa ngetikhumbuto ngaleso sikhatsi futsi kwentiwa ngalokungako ekusebenteni. Loko lonako lapha kwakhiwe ngelenhlonipho letfutfukisa kulandzela lokutsatfwa ngulokholelwa kutsi unako konkhe lokudingako ukwenta loko — bese uyaveza kutsi uyakwazi.
home.missionPara3Post: — kukhandza lakwente lapha imdlalo yebhodi: indlela lekhombisa kubatsandza yinyatselo konkhe kanyekanye, uhlale ulindzela labo labasemuva, ngobe utabadinga ngemuva. Mission kuphumela konkhe emazingeni lapho konkhe kuchubeka ekhaya. KUSHOLI siwati kutsi kufanele kube ngomunye mission kuphela, ngobe ematfuba ekuhlokisa engetsekti.
home.missionPara4: Ditshego Ventures liyabonga kubo bonkhe labente loku kwenteka. Kubongela kutawufaneleka kahle — emkhosini lobulene, ngendlela yomsebenti lotakhelekile.
home.socialSubtitle: Thola tinchwana tekutadisha, tintfo telikhasimusi, naletili khandze kwabanta wentanyalephijukane ephephini lemasiko.
